title: TTP Investments Inc. Sells 429 Shares of Apple Inc. (AAPL)
text:
Tweet
TTP Investments Inc. lessened its holdings in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 5.3% during the first quarter, according to the company in its most recent disclosure with the SEC. The firm owned 7,633 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 429 shares during the quarter. Apple comprises 1.2% of TTP Investments Inc.’s portfolio, making the stock its 13th largest position. TTP Investments Inc.’s holdings in Apple were worth $1,281,000 as of its most recent SEC filing.
A number of other institutional investors and hedge funds have also made changes to their positions in AAPL. Gibraltar Capital Management Inc. grew its holdings in Apple by 2.0% in the fourth quarter. Gibraltar Capital Management Inc. now owns 73,459 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $12,431,000 after purchasing an additional 1,431 shares during the period. Sicart Associates LLC grew its holdings in Apple by 18.9% in the fourth quarter. Sicart Associates LLC now owns 28,320 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $4,793,000 after purchasing an additional 4,500 shares during the period. Accredited Investors Inc. grew its holdings in Apple by 3.6% in the fourth quarter. Accredited Investors Inc. now owns 37,271 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $6,307,000 after purchasing an additional 1,301 shares during the period. Sky Investment Group LLC purchased a new stake in Apple in the fourth quarter worth about $223,000. Finally, DAVENPORT & Co LLC grew its holdings in Apple by 1.0% in the fourth quarter. DAVENPORT & Co LLC now owns 385,339 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $65,211,000 after purchasing an additional 3,871 shares during the period. Institutional investors and hedge funds own 58.39% of the company’s stock. Get Apple alerts:
Shares of AAPL stock opened at $207.39 on Friday. Apple Inc. has a 12-month low of $149.16 and a 12-month high of $208.38. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.84, a quick ratio of 1.37 and a current ratio of 1.31. The company has a market capitalization of $1,022.41 billion, a P/E ratio of 22.52, a P/E/G ratio of 1.59 and a beta of 1.16. Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its earnings results on Tuesday, July 31st. The iPhone maker reported $2.34 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, topping the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $2.18 by $0.16. Apple had a net margin of 21.98% and a return on equity of 43.50%. The company had revenue of $53.27 billion for the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $52.43 billion. During the same quarter last year, the company posted $1.67 earnings per share. The firm’s quarterly revenue was up 17.3% on a year-over-year basis. equities analysts predict that Apple Inc. will post 11.66 EPS for the current year.
Apple declared that its board has authorized a stock buyback program on Tuesday, May 1st that allows the company to repurchase $100.00 billion in outstanding shares. This repurchase authorization allows the iPhone maker to purchase up to 11.9% of its stock through open market purchases. Stock repurchase programs are usually a sign that the company’s management believes its shares are undervalued.
The business also recently announced a quarterly dividend, which will be paid on Thursday, August 16th. Investors of record on Monday, August 13th will be issued a $0.73 dividend. This represents a $2.92 annualized dividend and a yield of 1.41%. The ex-dividend date of this dividend is Friday, August 10th. Apple’s dividend payout ratio is currently 31.70%.
In other Apple news, COO Jeffrey E. Williams sold 15,653 shares of the stock in a transaction that occurred on Tuesday, May 8th. The shares were sold at an average price of $185.18, for a total value of $2,898,622.54. Following the transaction, the chief operating officer now directly owns 168,181 shares in the company, valued at $31,143,757.58. The transaction was disclosed in a legal filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which can be accessed through this hyperlink . Also, Director Arthur D. Levinson sold 35,000 shares of the stock in a transaction that occurred on Wednesday, May 9th. The stock was sold at an average price of $185.99, for a total transaction of $6,509,650.00. Following the completion of the transaction, the director now owns 1,168,283 shares in the company, valued at $217,288,955.17. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders sold 130,510 shares of company stock worth $24,499,179 in the last 90 days. 0.08% of the stock is currently owned by corporate insiders.
AAPL has been the topic of a number of recent research reports. Monness Crespi & Hardt initiated coverage on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, April 11th. They issued a “buy” rating and a $235.00 price objective on the stock. Zacks Investment Research cut shares of Apple from a “hold” rating to a “sell” rating in a report on Wednesday, April 11th. Royal Bank of Canada set a $203.00 price target on shares of Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a report on Wednesday, April 11th. Morgan Stanley cut their price target on shares of Apple from $203.00 to $200.00 and set an “overweight” rating on the stock in a report on Friday, April 20th. Finally, UBS Group set a $190.00 price target on shares of Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a report on Tuesday, April 24th. One research analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, fifteen have assigned a hold rating, thirty-three have given a buy rating and one has given a strong buy rating to the stock. Apple currently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and an average price target of $217.59.
Apple Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
